_comment: Capital and allocation config. Edit this file to adjust strategy budgets and position sizing. Restart atos_runner.py for changes to take effect.

account._sim_max_trade_notional_eur_comment: 2026-09-01 (user): SIM is for testing strategies, not for size. Hard ceiling on the NOTIONAL value of any single SIM entry -- forex/stocks/ETF. A signal whose computed size exceeds this is scaled DOWN to it (then floored to the instrument minimum); the strategy's risk math is untouched, only the absolute position size. WHY: even at 0.25% risk, low-ATR forex pairs sized to ~EUR 180,000 notional on a ~EUR 27,800 base (e.g. 196,000x USDHKD), and forex+futures margin exposure hit EUR 5.4M. Win-rate / expectancy / R-multiple are scale-invariant, so smaller size costs the study nothing. FUTURES ARE EXEMPT -- one contract is already the floor and can't be shrunk. Set 0 to disable.

us_reversion._max_slots_comment: 6 -> 10, 2026-08-28: explicit user request ('extend up to 10, if we got more signals we buy more'). max_universe_pct (10%) would derive ~38-41 slots off the current 385-407 ticker universe -- reversion_max_slots() in atos/capital_config.py caps that, so this is the real ceiling. Each slot shrinks a bit (~1/10 of the sleeve vs ~1/6) but stays well above 1-share-per-slot territory.

_futures_comment: The Saxo account is denominated in EUR. risk_equity_eur is the equity base
futures position sizing risks 1% of per trade. It exists because the runner
previously sized off the raw SIM TotalValue (~957,000 EUR of demo credit),
which made positions roughly 34x larger than the 300,000 SEK of intended
capital and got MACD/Squeeze orders rejected outright by the broker.
27800 EUR was 300,000 SEK at ~10.8 SEK/EUR -- i.e. the whole stated account.
2026-08-24: raised to 55200 (explicit request) so DAX/HK50/YM/NQ/ZC clear
'only 2/13 markets tradeable' finding for the per-market numbers this solves.
This means futures alone is now sized as if backed by ~600,000 SEK, double
the account's stated 300,000 SEK -- forex still uses its own 27800 EUR (real
300,000 SEK) unchanged. LOWER THIS if futures should go back to sharing
capital with the ATOS equity sleeves instead of exceeding the full account.
_forex_comment: Same story as futures: forex/runner.py sized off the raw SIM TotalValue
(~945,000 EUR of demo credit), making positions roughly 33x the intended
300,000 SEK. Unlike futures, FX trades in fine unit increments, so capping
scales positions down cleanly instead of making markets untradeable.

_lbo_comment: London Breakout is documented as a separate day-trading book with its own
15,000 SEK capital, but the runner was passing it the FULL account equity,

_forex_live_comment: 2026-08-25: the real-money Saxo LIVE forex account, entirely separate from
the SIM account above -- different broker account, different Saxo app
registration, different state file (data/forex_live_state.json). The account
itself is opened/funded in SEK, so risk_equity_sek is a direct figure, no
EUR conversion needed (unlike forex/futures SIM above).
2026-08-28: raised 6,000 -> 15,000 SEK, explicit user decision (via
AskUserQuestion: 'One unified cap, both strategies share it'), after
confirming live via Saxo's own /port/v1/balances/me that the SEK/EUR/USD
sub-accounts are NOT separately funded at all -- querying ANY of the 3
AccountKeys returns the identical pooled CashBalance (~15,770 SEK that day),
always reported in SEK. There was never really '6,000 SEK here, 500 EUR
there' as two separate pots -- both were always artificial software slices
of the SAME one real balance. 15,000 (not the exact 15,770) leaves a small
buffer since the real balance drifts with margin/P&L day to day. Paired
with forex_live_eur's risk_equity_eur below (~equivalent amount, same real
pool) and LIVE_RISK_PCT_OVERRIDE=0.75% (forex/runner.py) -- together these
unlock 14 of the 34 (17 HIGH_VOLUME_SYMBOLS pairs x rsi/bb) cells that
clear both the risk gate and the cost gate. IMPORTANT KNOWN GAP: each
account's own portfolio heat cap (_heat_allows_entry()) only sees ITS OWN
open positions (separate state files) -- it has no visibility into the
other account's exposure against this same shared real pool, so real
aggregate risk can exceed what either account's own 8% heat check shows.
Restricted by explicit user decision to exactly rsi (see forex/runner.py's
LIVE_ALLOWED_STRATEGIES, switched bb->rsi 2026-08-31) on the 17
HIGH_VOLUME_SYMBOLS pairs only.

keep per-trade risk at the RSI_LIVE_FIXED_RISK_EUR=45 / ~500 SEK fixed

Per-trade risk is UNCHANGED (fixed EUR45); the effect is the 8% RSI heat
cap now allows ~5-6 concurrent RSI positions here vs ~2-3 at 15,000.

User kept this at EUR 8,000 (still ~2.4x the real EUR share) -- the SEK

Risk % stays 0.75%. Paired with an RSI-ONLY 8% heat cap

a full RSI book + the SEK account could still hit Saxo's real 50% margin gate
(_margin_allows_entry), which is the intended hard backstop.
